name: flutter_riverpod
summary: A reactive caching and data-binding framework for Flutter with provider-based dependency management and first-class asynchronous state handling.
advantages: First-class Future and Stream-oriented state patterns
Providers can be composed and accessed outside the widget tree
Optional code generation reduces repetitive declarations
tradeoffs: Introduces Riverpod-specific lifecycle and provider concepts
Generator-based usage adds build tooling and generated files
recommendedFor: Applications with substantial asynchronous or shared state
Projects that want dependency access without relying on BuildContext
Projects that value provider composition, caching and testability

verification.reason: Current Riverpod documentation and pub.dev metadata are sufficient; flutter_riverpod 3.4.3 is the current stable package version found.
